name: mts-event-manager
description: Event editor, timeline preview, checks and authoring helpers for Mind the School (Ren'Py) events and mods — with a StudioNeoV2 capture plugin.

mtsEventManager.capture.enabled.description: Export the event open in the event editor for the StudioNeoV2 capture plugin (MTS Capture): its image targets, as a JSON bridge file.

mtsEventManager.capture.bridgeFile.description: Bridge file for the StudioNeoV2 capture plugin. Empty: %LOCALAPPDATA%\MTS-Event-Manager\capture\active-event.json (the plugin's default too).

mtsEventManager.checkForUpdates.description: Once a day, check GitHub for a newer release of MTS Event Manager (and the MTS Capture plugin) and offer a link to the release post.

mtsEventManager.enableCodeLens.description: Show CodeLens on scene labels (preview, go to / edit the event definition) and on Event(...) definitions (go to label, + Condition / + Selector / + Pattern).

mtsEventManager.enableDiagnostics.description: Validate the arguments of Event(...) definitions against the condition/selector/option classes discovered in the workspace.

mtsEventManager.enableImagePreview.description: Hover previews (auto-rotating carousel) on image calls: image.show, show_image, show_pattern, show_video, set_background.

mtsEventManager.enablePaperdoll.description: Hover previews of the resolved paperdoll sprite on register_paperdoll / .display(...) calls.

mtsEventManager.enablePortraits.description: Show character portraits inline before dialogue speaker variables.

mtsEventManager.imageHoverSecondsPerFram.description: Seconds each image is shown in the hover auto-carousel.

mtsEventManager.imageRoots.description: Additional base folders for resolving Pattern image paths (absolute or workspace-relative). Workspace **/game folders and game/mods/* (mod asset roots) are always included.
